title: Sweet Stamppot Fish
description: A Chinese-inspired dish made with fish, stamppot, and sweet ingredients.
instructions: Season fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Sear fish for 2 minutes per side.
Transfer fish to the oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat sweet soy sauce in a separate pan over medium heat.
Add stamppot to the pan and stir-fry until heated through.
Serve fish with stamppot mixture spooned over the top.
